name: January
title: Where to go on holiday in January
intro: Escape the grey with winter sun in the Caribbean or Asia, or go the other way for snow, huskies and the northern lights. Here's where's at its best in January.
seo_title: Where is hot in January? Winter sun, snow and where to go

sections.heading: The short answer
sections.text:
January is the coldest month of the year across Europe, so for real warmth you have two choices. The Canary Islands, about four hours away, are the warmest part of Europe, with afternoons around 20 to 22°C. For proper heat, 28°C and above, you need a long-haul flight: the Caribbean, Mexico, Thailand, Sri Lanka, India and the Maldives are all in their dry season.

It's also a good month to go the other way. The Alps have deep snow, and Lapland and northern Norway have the long dark nights that make for the best northern lights.

The temperatures below are average daytime highs for January, rounded. Flight times are typical direct flights from London; regional airports are similar, give or take half an hour. Everywhere at its best in January is listed above, with its average temperature.

sections.heading: The ranking at a glance
sections.text:
The warmest places within about six hours of the UK:

- **1. [Cape Verde](/destinations/cape-verde):** around 25°C, dry but often windy. About 6 hours.
- **2. Luxor and the [Nile](/destinations/nile-cruise):** around 23°C by day, cold at night. About 5 hours.
- **3. [Tenerife](/destinations/tenerife) and [Gran Canaria](/destinations/gran-canaria):** around 22°C, sunniest in the south. About 4 hours 15 minutes.
- **4. [Lanzarote](/destinations/lanzarote) and [Fuerteventura](/destinations/fuerteventura):** around 20 to 21°C, dry and breezy. About 4 hours.
- **5. [Madeira](/destinations/madeira):** around 19°C, greener and wetter. About 3 hours 50 minutes.
- **6. [Marrakech](/destinations/marrakech) and [Essaouira](/destinations/essaouira):** around 18 to 19°C by day, but chilly nights. About 3 hours 30 minutes.
- **7. [Málaga](/destinations/malaga) and [Seville](/destinations/seville):** around 16 to 17°C and often sunny. About 2 hours 45 minutes.
- **8. [Paphos](/destinations/paphos) and [Malta](/destinations/malta):** around 16 to 17°C, with some of their wettest weeks of the year. 3 to 4 hours 30 minutes.

sections.heading: Under five hours: the Canary Islands
sections.text:
The Canaries are the default January sun holiday from the UK for good reason. They sit off the coast of Africa, on the same time as the UK, and January afternoons in the south of Tenerife and Gran Canaria are usually in the low twenties with plenty of sunshine. Lanzarote and Fuerteventura are a degree or so cooler and windier, but very dry.

Two things to plan for. The sea is around 18 to 19°C, which is fresh, so a hotel with a heated pool makes a big difference. And where you stay matters: the north of Tenerife and Gran Canaria is cloudier and cooler than the south. The first two weeks of January, straight after New Year, are often the cheapest time of the whole winter to go.

sections.heading: Properly hot: long-haul in its dry season
sections.text:
January is one of the best months of the year for long-haul sunshine, because so many places are dry at once.

- **The Caribbean:** [Barbados](/destinations/barbados), [Antigua](/destinations/antigua), [St Lucia](/destinations/st-lucia) and [Grenada](/destinations/grenada) are around 28 to 29°C, with direct flights of about eight to nine hours.
- **Mexico:** [Cancún](/destinations/cancun) and [Bacalar](/destinations/bacalar) are warm and dry, and inland [Oaxaca](/destinations/oaxaca) and [Mérida](/destinations/merida) are at their most comfortable.
- **Thailand and Malaysia:** [Phuket](/destinations/phuket), [Koh Lanta](/destinations/koh-lanta), [Koh Samui](/destinations/koh-samui) and [Langkawi](/destinations/langkawi) are around 29 to 32°C and dry.
- **South Asia and the Indian Ocean:** [Sri Lanka](/destinations/sri-lanka)'s south and west coasts, [Goa](/destinations/goa), [Kerala](/destinations/kerala) and the [Maldives](/destinations/maldives) are all in season.
- **Closer to home:** [Dubai](/destinations/dubai) and [Oman](/destinations/oman), around seven hours away, are around 24 to 25°C, warm rather than hot.

[Costa Rica](/destinations/costa-rica) and [Cartagena](/destinations/cartagena) are in their dry season too, and in the southern hemisphere it's summer in [Cape Town](/destinations/cape-town) and [Sydney](/destinations/sydney).

sections.heading: Snow: skiing and the northern lights
sections.text:
January is a quieter, cheaper month in the Alps than February half term or Easter, with cold, reliable snow. [Chamonix](/destinations/chamonix), [Val Thorens](/destinations/val-thorens), [St Anton](/destinations/st-anton) and [Zermatt](/destinations/zermatt) are all in full swing, and [Bansko](/destinations/bansko) and [Andorra](/destinations/andorra) are cheaper places to learn. Our [ski holidays](/destinations/ski-holidays) page has the full list.

Further north, the nights are long and dark, which is what you want for the northern lights. [Tromsø](/destinations/tromso) is milder than you'd expect, around -2°C, while Finnish Lapland, [Rovaniemi](/destinations/rovaniemi), [Levi](/destinations/levi) and [Saariselkä](/destinations/saariselka), is much colder, often -10°C or below, with deep snow for husky and reindeer rides. Once the Christmas crowds have gone, January is usually cheaper than December.

sections.heading: City breaks in January
sections.text: January is low season for most European cities, so hotels are at their cheapest and museums are quiet. It's cold, so pick cities with plenty to do indoors, or ones that are a little milder. [Seville](/destinations/seville) and [Málaga](/destinations/malaga) are often sunny and around 16°C. [Lisbon](/destinations/lisbon) and [Porto](/destinations/porto) are mild but can be wet. For the full list, see our [city breaks](/destinations/city-breaks) page.

sections.heading: How to choose
sections.text:
Start with how far you're willing to fly. For a week of sunshine with no jet lag and a short flight, the south of Tenerife or Gran Canaria is the safest bet. For guaranteed heat and a beach you can swim from, the Caribbean or Thailand are worth the extra hours. For something completely different, snow and the northern lights are at their best now.

If you're choosing as a family or group and everyone wants something different, put a few on a shortlist and let everyone vote with points. That's what somewhere🎉 is for, and our guide to [deciding where to go on holiday](/how-to-decide-where-to-go-on-holiday) explains how it works.

faqs.question: Where is hot in January?
faqs.answer: The Caribbean (Barbados, Grenada, Cancún), the Maldives, Sri Lanka, Thailand and Dubai are all warm and mostly dry in January. Cape Town and Sydney are in high summer. Closer to home, Tenerife is mild rather than hot, at around 20 to 22°C.

faqs.question: Where can we see snow or the northern lights in January?
faqs.answer: Tromsø and Rovaniemi have long dark nights for the northern lights, plus husky rides and reindeer. Chamonix and Whistler are in the heart of the ski season.

faqs.question: Is January a cheap time to go on holiday?
faqs.answer: Often, yes. Once the New Year week is over, flights and hotels in Europe drop to some of their lowest prices of the year. Long-haul winter sun stays in high season, so book those early.

faqs.question: Where is the hottest place in Europe in January?
faqs.answer: The south of Tenerife and Gran Canaria, with average January highs of around 22°C. The other Canary Islands are close behind at around 20 to 21°C.

faqs.question: Where is hot in January with a short flight?
faqs.answer: The Canary Islands, about four hours from the UK, are the warmest. Cape Verde, at about six hours, is warmer still. Southern Spain and Portugal are under three hours away but only mild, around 16 to 17°C.

faqs.question: Where is hot in January long-haul?
faqs.answer: The Caribbean, Mexico, Thailand, Malaysia, Sri Lanka, Goa, Kerala and the Maldives are all hot and dry in January, around 28 to 32°C.
